retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic urban layout featuring a central horizontal photographic strip with motion blur, framed by deep blue blocks and ultra-wide letter-spaced sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: horizontal photographic band with color wash

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier horizontal composition consisting of a top dark blue header with widely spaced lowercase text, a central photographic band showing a group in an urban setting with heavy motion blur on the right, and a bottom dark blue footer containing thin horizontal red and blue lines and a secondary title in italicized condensed type.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal banding dividing the canvas into three distinct zones
Monochromatic blue color wash unifying the photography and background
Contrast between static central subjects and dynamic motion-blurred background
Extreme letter-spacing in the top header creating a rhythmic horizontal line
coreInvariants: Ultra-wide tracking on the top display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four male subjects positioned mid-ground within the central horizontal band, scaled from chest-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central group portrait provides the primary focus, anchored by the dark blue blocks above and below.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the widely spaced top text, down to the faces in the center, then follows the motion blur to the right, ending at the bottom-right title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large blocks of solid navy blue at the top and bottom provide significant negative space for typographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Navy Blue (Background and color wash)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan/Light Blue (Highlights in photography and motion blur)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Red (Thin horizontal lines in the footer)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the photographic highlights against the dark background.

letterConstructionRules: Lowercase only for the top header
Italicized and condensed for the bottom title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Two variations of a condensed sans-serif: one widely spaced and upright, the other tightly packed and italicized.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule lines in alternating red and blue

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold skeleton of the secondary title.
Provides the clean, uniform stroke weight needed for the top header.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a three-tier horizontal layout. The top and bottom thirds are solid deep navy blue. The middle third is a photographic strip of four men in dark shirts standing in a city at night, with heavy cyan-toned motion blur on the right side. In the bottom blue section, add a series of thin, horizontal parallel lines in red and blue.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase text in a condensed sans-serif to the top blue section with extreme letter spacing. Add a second title in the bottom right in a bold, italicized, extra-condensed sans-serif in pale yellow-green, positioned over the horizontal lines.

verificationChecks: Is the top text lowercase and extremely widely spaced?
Is the central image a horizontal strip with motion blur?
Are there thin horizontal lines in the bottom section?
Is the overall color palette dominated by deep blue?

adjustableVariables: Width of the central photographic strip
Intensity of the blue color wash
Amount of letter spacing in the top header
Number of horizontal lines in the footer
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the top text is lowercase.
Verify the motion blur is directed horizontally.
Check that the red lines are thin and parallel.
Confirm the blue wash covers the central photo.
recipe.reuseFormula: Deep blue background + horizontal photo strip + motion blur + extreme tracking sans-serif = Urban Cinematic Layout
